<section class="section workflow-section" id="workflow" aria-labelledby="workflow-heading">

:::::: page-shell
::: section-intro
<h2 id="workflow-heading">

From evidence to action.

</h2>

<p>Design For Impact builds on the Q<sub>1</sub>Q<sub>2</sub>Q<sub>3</sub> framework developed by Vance and colleagues, which moves from qualitative context gathering, through quantitative analysis, to qualitative interpretation.</p>
:::

<ol class="workflow-flow" aria-label="Q1, Q2, Q3 workflow">

<li>

<p class="workflow-code">

Q<sub>1</sub>

</p>

<p class="workflow-type">

Qualitative

</p>

<h3>Alignment</h3>

</li>

<li class="flow-arrow" aria-hidden="true">

→

</li>

<li>

<p class="workflow-code">

Q<sub>2</sub>

</p>

<p class="workflow-type">

Quantitative

</p>

<h3>Intentionality</h3>

</li>

<li class="flow-arrow" aria-hidden="true">

→

</li>

<li>

<p class="workflow-code">

Q<sub>3</sub>

</p>

<p class="workflow-type">

Qualitative

</p>

<h3>Translation</h3>

</li>

</ol>

::: workflow-notes
<article>

<h3>Alignment</h3>

<p>Establish the project’s broader vision, intended impact, and expectations for the partnership.</p>

</article>

<article>

<h3>Intentionality</h3>

<p>Choose the design, dataset, analytical approach, and communication products that enable the intended impact.</p>

</article>

<article>

<h3>Translation</h3>

<p>Develop an audience-specific, evidence-based narrative connecting the findings to the stakeholders, decisions, or actions identified in Q<sub>1</sub>.</p>

</article>
:::

::: section-close
<p>The tool turns these principles into five practical components.</p>

<a class="text-action" href="tool.qmd">Explore the Tool [→]{aria-hidden="true"}</a>
:::
::::::

</section>

<section class="section implementation-section" aria-labelledby="implementation-heading">

:::: page-shell
::: {.section-intro .split-heading}
<h2 id="implementation-heading">

A scaffold, not a script.

</h2>

<p>Use the tool as a shared document between you and your collaborator, or adapt it to your needs.</p>
:::

<ol class="lifecycle">

<li>

<h3>Prepare</h3>

<p>Review the guide and develop questions before kickoff.</p>

</li>

<li>

<h3>Align</h3>

<p>Establish Q<sub>1</sub> with collaborators and confirm shared understanding.</p>

</li>

<li>

<h3>Analyze</h3>

<p>Develop Q<sub>2</sub> and revisit it as evidence or constraints change.</p>

</li>

<li>

<h3>Translate</h3>

<p>Use Q<sub>3</sub> to shape decision-ready closeout communication.</p>

</li>

</ol>

<a class="text-action" href="tool.qmd">See Implementation Guidance [→]{aria-hidden="true"}</a>
::::

</section>
